description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'I18NLanguageAPI' for managing internationalization (i18n) language records within an admin module, including actions like listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting languages. It leverages the OrangeHRM framework's API, traits, and models to implement RESTful operations.
